description: Spatial datasets of CMIP6 climate change projections for Canada and the United States is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Geospatial climate change projections are used to assess climate change impacts and adaptations across a wide range of disciplines. Here we present monthly-based grids of climate change projections at a 2-km resolution covering Canada and the United States. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are Climate change; Geospatial data; General Circulation Models; Shared socio-economic pathways; CMIP6; Downscaling; Canada; United States, Climate change, Climate, Temperature, Modelling. It offers 1 resource(s) in TIFF. The portal shows 2024-11-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
